description: Per-tile cover icons on every terrain piece (doc §6). Each icon is BoardRoot/TerrainCoverOverlay/TerrainCoverIcon_<terrain_id>: a shield at the piece's polygon area centroid whose Label is TerrainManager.cover_type_of(piece) — the 11e category on the doc's light/heavy/blocking ladder (exposed +1, light +2, dense LB). The chips are opt-in (later design decision: Settings > Visual > 'Terrain Cover Labels', OFF by default), so the scenario turns them on through the real Settings menu (Escape, Visual tab, click the checkbox, Escape) and off again the same way. Asserts per terrain_id: the node exists, sits within 8px of its polygon centroid, modulate.a >= 0.8 and its label matches the cover type; on the fitted whole-board view the overlay-on capture differs from the overlay-off capture by > 1% overall and > 1% of the board region; every glyph keeps a 1:1 upright on-screen size at the fitted view, zoom 1.0, zoom 0.5 and with the board rotated 90 degrees; no icon touches a token base at the fixture's deployment positions; icons draw below the tokens; and the icons rebuild (same names, labels, centroids) when the shipped default layout is loaded.
